python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json,base64,hashlib,subprocess,os,time
rows=json.loads("[{\"path\":\"ImbalancedChen/P3OriginalU5RoundedCountReserve.lean\",\"base64\":\"\",\"sha256\":\"26f094146c02dfad6f9b9d04353fde33cc0ce6d0319ee3c194463bfe1a323e92\"},{\"path\":\"docs/part3-distribution/continuation-20261127-p36/P36RoundedCorrectionAudit.lean\",\"base64\":\"\",\"sha256\":\"dc4148ba41de37f6b2896dd30c57d235c6583c4d07e6101a8c39691d1530274f\"}]")
root=Path('/workspace/p36-rounded-correction-20261127')
pref=json.loads((root/'PREFLIGHT.json').read_text());assert pref['status']=='MATCHED_ACCEPTED_SOURCES_AND_OBJECTS'
for r in rows:
 dest=root/('ImbalancedChen/P3OriginalU5RoundedCountReserve.lean' if r['path'].startswith('ImbalancedChen/') else 'P36RoundedCorrectionAudit.lean')
 data=base64.b64decode(r['base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==r['sha256'];dest.write_bytes(data)
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(LEAN_PATH=pref['lean_path'],LEAN_SYSROOT='/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux',LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1')
src=root/'ImbalancedChen/P3OriginalU5RoundedCountReserve.lean';obj=root/'objects/ImbalancedChen/P3OriginalU5RoundedCountReserve.olean';log=root/'logs/count-attempt-001.log'
cmd=['/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux/bin/lean','-t0','-j1','-DwarningAsError=true','-R',str(root),'-o',str(obj),str(src)]
tick=time.monotonic()
with log.open('w') as h:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=h,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
record={'command':cmd,'exit_code':r.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-tick,'source_sha256':sha(src),'object_sha256':sha(obj) if r.returncode==0 else None,'log_sha256':sha(log)}
(root/'count-compile-record.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(record,indent=2));print(log.read_text())
raise SystemExit(r.returncode)
